notes:
Beta 1.5.19 - richer SFX across plugin actions.

New _sfx runtime module: synthesises proper WAV resources on first run (sine + harmonic blends, ADSR envelopes) and pre-loads them into SoundPool. No audio assets are shipped — the WAVs are generated on the device. Covers click / open / close / success / complete / error / badge / copy / toggle.

Wired into more plugin actions: open rating dialog, open stars-balance dialog, save rating, save stars balance, toggle official-gifts visibility, open Copy-NFT dialog. The update popup keeps a ToneGenerator fallback for the very first install (before the runtime files are downloaded).
